name: Sacred Bolt
body:
School evocation; Level antipaladin 1, cleric/oracle 0, legendary inquisitor 0, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect projectile
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

With a word, you hurl a spear of divine energy at your adversary. Make a ranged attack against the target, dealing 1d4 points of damage on a successful hit. The damage dealt by this spell is considered either lawful, good, evil, or chaotic, the spell gaining the descriptor corresponding to its damage type.
